agreement.authority: Repository owner, explicit 'Yes I approve' reply to the T23a contract proposal

origin: southwest outer cell edge; first centre offset by half the grid spacing
orientation: rows south to north; columns west to east; row-major
layout: 258*258 little-endian float32, then 258*258 uint8; offset=4*(r*258+c); maskOffset=4*258*258+r*258+c
validity: 0 missing with value 0; 1 finite valid value; padding outside the native array is missing
interpolation: one bilinear interpolation from native cells; texelFetch; positive-weight missing contributor invalidates result; no weight renormalization
bounds: half-open native outer-cell footprint; inside footprint clamp fractional indices to native edge centres
wgs84_to_native: WGS84 geodetic lon/lat h=0 -> Cartesian WGS84 -> inverse Cartesian sphere R=6371229; Greenwich, zero datum shift prototype hypothesis
native_2d_to_wgs84: intersect native geocentric ray with WGS84 h=0; lon unchanged; phi=atan2(sin(native_phi),(1-e2)*cos(native_phi)); e2=f*(2-f), f=1/298.257223563; poles at +/-90

readiness.mode: lazy with eager deterministic representative probes before metadata is ready
